measurement: P4 — the inspect-first baseline on a PROVISIONAL v3 80 (理's post-hoc check)
status: PROVISIONAL. Nothing was emitted to experience/tasks; the 80 live in the scratchpad, each stamped _PROVISIONAL, and `gen` still refuses while P1/P2 are unruled.
the_P4_question: are the programs behaviourally DISTINCT, or superficially different and behaviourally identical? A set of the second kind passes P0 and P3 and is v2 again with more strings. No gate on the tasks can see it.

the_answer.verdict: P4 PASSES. The programs are behaviourally distinct -- 77 different trajectories from 80 different programs, against v2-i where 80 episodes were 11 problems and trajectories repeated by construction.

and_the_number_that_is_new_this_week: n = 80 PROBLEMS. P0 ratio 1.000. This is the first task set in the programme where 80 episodes means 80 observations, so 18.8% carries an SE of ~4.4 points instead of resting on eleven deterministic outcomes.

THE_CONCERN_I_AM_RAISING_RATHER_THAN_BUR.observed: 8 distinct (green, actions) outcomes, largest group 65. Sixty-five of eighty episodes fail identically at the budget of 12.
THE_CONCERN_I_AM_RAISING_RATHER_THAN_BUR.why_it_matters: trajectory diversity is high but OUTCOME resolution is coarse. An intervention has to convert episodes out of that block of 65 to be visible at all; anything that changes the route without changing the destination measures zero, which is the shape the whole week has been finding.
THE_CONCERN_I_AM_RAISING_RATHER_THAN_BUR.what_it_is_NOT: it is not the v2 defect. v2's episodes were identical because the TASKS were identical; v3's failures are identical because failing costs the full budget. Different cause, and only the first one makes the set degenerate.
the_fixes_available_and_their_costs: more n -- now cheap, since a signature is a file and 300 costs ~20 seconds of generation. This is the honest fix and it does not change the task.
a larger budget -- would let more episodes finish, but changes the loop and breaks comparability with everything measured at 12.
easier programs -- would raise the rate and is the WRONG fix: it tunes the benchmark to the agent, which is how v1 and v2 got where they are.

localisation_at_30_percent: against a chance rate of ~20% for 4-6 regions, the agent is barely above chance. v3 does not hand the region to anything -- P3 measured a held-out symptom table at 0.0-3.3%, so there is no key to read.
bounds: PROVISIONAL set, generated with seed 21 for measurement only.
